proceduralAmbient.origin: Original geometry, shaders and animation curves authored in the Vrooli living-world source. No imported wildlife models, textures, rigs or animation clips.
proceduralAmbient.rights: Project source terms apply; these are not assets from the CC0 vendor kits.
proceduralAmbient.runtimeRecipe: Construct bounded Three.js geometry once per mounted presenter; derive motion from the shared absolute clock and seeded habitat sites. No external asset fetch or skeletal animation bake.

fireflies.technique: Point sprites with a procedural halo; vertical sine motion and glow phase.

butterflies.technique: Original triangulated wings, body and antennae; vertex-shader flapping and terrain-relative figure-eight flight.

birds.technique: Original triangulated wings, body, beak and tail; vertex-shader flap/glide blend and circular habitat routes.

rabbits.technique: Sixteen scaled low-poly sphere instances per rabbit; absolute-time grazing, nibbling, smooth travel and hop curves.

fish.technique: Scaled low-poly spheres for body, tail, eyes and splash drops; ring geometry for ripple; analytic jump, splash and fade curves.

sky.technique: Pooled planes with original trail/comet fragment shaders and absolute-time deterministic event schedules.

celestial.technique: Original camera-centred sky meshes and point field; procedural gradient/cloud noise, lunar shading and galactic dust band; shared civil-time quiet-hours envelope. No imported sky bitmap beyond the existing reflection HDR.

squirrels.technique: Nineteen scaled primitive parts per squirrel; bounded exposed-trunk habitats, forage, dart, leap, climb and perch poses sampled from absolute time.

campfires.technique: Ten low-poly stones, two crossed procedural flame cards, one ember card and six billboard smoke puffs per hearth. Three instanced draws, shared quiet-hour/weather envelope and world clock. Effect meshes explicitly opt out of furniture collision.

proceduralAmbient.qualification: Source provenance only. Final art approval and combined maximum-load qualification are separate requirements.

proceduralArchitecture.technique: Original instanced box and gabled-roof geometry with physical text signs; shared structural boxes drive navigation and rendering; camera/body roof collision uses the rendered triangles.
